0.headline: Goldman, Templeton, Fidelity said to plan buying into NSE IPO
0.heading: Goldman, Templeton, Fidelity said to plan buying into NSE IPO
0.intro: The anchor book is likely to be about Rs 6,800 crore, Bloomberg reported
0.body:
Goldman Sachs Asset Management, Franklin Templeton, and Fidelity International Ltd. are among the global first set to participate as anchor investors in National Stock Exchange of India Ltd.’s initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter, as the bourse prepares to raise as much as Rs 22,600 crore ($2.4 billion).

Norges Bank Investment Management, Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, GIC, Eastspring Investments Services Pte Ltd., Millennium Management, Marshall Wace, Citadel Capital and Ghisallo Capital Management are also among those likely to subscribe to the anchor book, the people said, asking not to be identified because the information is private.

The anchor book is likely to be about Rs 6,800 crore, the people said. Some prominent money managers including Capital Group, BlackRock Inc., Aberdeen Group PLC, FMR LLC and T. Rowe Price Group Inc. are likely to skip the offering amid concerns over valuation, they said.

The anchor allotment process is still ongoing, and the final investor lineup may change, the people said. Fidelity International, Eastspring, GIC, ADIA, Norges Bank, Aberdeen, and Citadel declined to comment, while representatives for NSE and the other funds didn’t respond to requests for comment.

The mixed response underscores the debate over NSE’s valuation even after the exchange lowered the price range for its long-awaited initial public offering. While its dominant market position and profitability have attracted strong investor interest, some funds remain wary of the price they are being asked to pay for future growth.

Investors are weighing slowing growth and tighter regulatory oversight of stock-market activity. Options trading, a key driver of the exchange’s earnings, has come under particular pressure as Indian authorities seek to curb speculative derivatives trading.

NSE, the world’s largest derivatives exchange by volume, will take orders from investors from September 17 through September 21, with a potential listing on September 24. The anchor book is scheduled to open on September 16.

The exchange set a price band of Rs 1,700 to Rs 1,785 a share, below an earlier marketed range of Rs 2,000 to Rs 2,100, people familiar with the matter have said. The lower range reflects an effort to strike a balance between NSE’s growth prospects and investor concerns over valuation and regulatory risks.

1.headline: Manipal Payment & Identity Solutions IPO allotment today: GMP signals flat listing; check status on registrar, BSE and NSE
1.heading: Manipal Payment & Identity Solutions IPO allotment today: GMP signals flat listing; check status on registrar, BSE and NSE
1.intro: The allotment of shares in Manipal Payment & Identity Solutions' Rs 805-crore initial public offering (IPO) is expected to be finalised today, September 15, after the issue saw a modest subscription during its three-day bidding window.
1.body:
The allotment of shares in Manipal Payment &amp; Identity Solutions' Rs 805-crore initial public offering (IPO) is expected to be finalised today, September 15, after the issue saw a modest subscription during its three-day bidding window.

The IPO was subscribed 1.42 times by the close of bidding on September 11, according to NSE data. Investors placed bids for 1.85 crore shares against 1.31 crore shares on offer. The retail portion was subscribed 2.19 times, while the non-institutional investor (NII) category received 1.22 times subscription.

The IPO opened on September 9 and closed on September 11, with the price band fixed at Rs 322-339 per share. The issue comprises a fresh issue of up to Rs 320 crore and an offer-for-sale (OFS) of up to Rs 485 crore. The shares are scheduled to list on the BSE and NSE on September 17.

Read Also: India's first F1 racer, built Rs 100-crore company: How Narain Karthikeyan founded DriveX after leaving racetrack

The grey market is signalling a largely flat debut for Manipal Payment &amp; Identity Solutions shares. According to the latest InvestorGain data, the GMP stood at around Rs 1 per share on September 15, implying an estimated listing price of Rs 340 against the upper issue price of Rs 339. This translates into a potential premium of roughly 0.29 percent.

GMP figures are unofficial and are based on activity in the unregulated grey market. They can fluctuate before listing and should not be viewed as a guarantee of the actual listing price or returns.

How to check Manipal Payment &amp; Identity Solutions IPO allotment status

Investors can check their allotment status through MUFG Intime India, the registrar to the issue, or through the BSE and NSE websites. The basis of allotment is scheduled for September 15, followed by refunds and demat credit on September 16. The stock is expected to list on September 17.

Manipal Payment &amp; Identity Solutions IPO allotment status via MUFG Intime India

Step 1. Visit MUFG Intime IPO allotment status at https://in.mpms.mufg.com/Initial_Offer/public-issues.html
Step 2. Select Manipal Payment &amp; Identity Solutions Ltd from the company list.
Step 3. Choose PAN, application number or DP/Client ID as the identification option.
Step 4. Enter the required details.
Step 5. Submit the form to view your allotment status.

Manipal Payment &amp; Identity Solutions IPO allotment status via BSE

1. Visit the BSE IPO application status at https://www.bseindia.com/investors/appli_check
2. Select Equity as the issue type.
3. Choose Manipal Payment &amp; Identity Solutions from the issue list.
4. Enter your PAN or application number.
5. Complete the captcha and click on Search.
6. Your allotment status will be displayed once the basis of allotment is finalised.

Manipal Payment &amp; Identity Solutions IPO allotment status via NSE

Step 1. Visit the NSE IPO bid verification page at https://www.nseindia.com/invest/check-trades-bids-verify-ipo-bids
Step 2. Select Equity &amp; SME IPO bid details.
Step 3. Choose MPIMANIPAL from the symbol dropdown.
Step 4. Enter your PAN or application number.
Step 5. Submit the details to check the bid and allotment information.

The Rs 805-crore offering consists of a fresh issue of Rs 320 crore and an OFS of Rs 485 crore by promoter Manipal Technologies. The price band was fixed at Rs 322-339 per share, while the minimum lot size was 44 shares.

At the upper price band, retail investors needed to invest Rs 14,916 for one lot.

Ahead of the public issue, the company raised Rs 362.25 crore from anchor investors on September 8. It allotted 1,06,85,841 shares to anchor investors at Rs 339 apiece.

The anchor book included domestic mutual fund schemes as well as institutional investors. Motilal Oswal AMC, Baroda BNP Paribas Mutual Fund, ITI Mutual Fund and Groww Mutual Fund collectively accounted for a sizeable portion of the domestic mutual fund allocation.

Manipal Payment &amp; Identity Solutions plans to deploy around Rs 238.4 crore from the fresh issue towards the purchase and installation of new and second-hand equipment.

The planned expenditure covers its card manufacturing facility, personalisation bureau and cheque printing facility, central card processing centres, and Smart Tagging and IoT Solutions facility. The remaining fresh issue proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.

Check IPO News Here

About Manipal Payment &amp; Identity Solutions

Incorporated in 2008, Manipal Payment &amp; Identity Solutions is part of the Manipal Group and provides payment, identification, secure solutions, smart tagging and IoT services.

Its customers include banks, fintech companies, non-banking financial companies and government entities across India and international markets. The company's portfolio includes payment cards, identity cards, cheque solutions, smart tagging and related secure-printing and technology solutions.

Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors, Axis Capital, ICICI Securities, IIFL Capital Services and Nuvama Wealth Management are the book-running lead managers, while MUFG Intime India Private Limited is the registrar to the issue.

2.headline: Arcil IPO allotment likely today at BSE, NSE and registrar; check latest GMP
2.heading: Arcil IPO allotment likely today at BSE, NSE and registrar; check latest GMP
2.intro: The allotment of shares in Asset Reconstruction Company (India), popularly known as Arcil, is expected to be finalised today, September 15, following strong demand for the company's Rs 732.97-crore initial public offering (IPO).
2.body:
The allotment of shares in Asset Reconstruction Company (India), popularly known as Arcil, is expected to be finalised today, September 15, following strong demand for the company's Rs 732.97-crore initial public offering (IPO).

The IPO was subscribed 20.10 times on the final day of bidding on September 11, according to NSE data. Investors placed bids for 74.20 crore equity shares against 3.69 crore shares on offer. Qualified institutional buyers (QIBs) subscribed 52.65 times, while the non-institutional investor (NII) portion was subscribed 15.69 times and the retail category 3.39 times.

The IPO was open from September 9 to September 11, with the price band fixed at Rs 132-139 per share. The issue is entirely an offer-for-sale (OFS) of up to 5.27 crore shares, meaning the company will not receive proceeds from the public issue. The shares are scheduled to list on the BSE and NSE on September 17.

Read Also: India's first F1 driver, built Rs 100-crore company: How Narain Karthikeyan founded DriveX after leaving racetrack

In the grey market, the shares of Arcil were commanding a premium of around 11 percent on the morning of September 15, according to InvestorGain.

GMP figures are unofficial and reflect activity in the unregulated grey market. They can change quickly and should not be treated as an assured listing gain or an indication of the company's fundamental value.

How to check Arcil IPO allotment status

Investors can check their Arcil IPO allotment status through MUFG Intime India, the registrar to the issue, as well as the BSE and NSE websites. The basis of allotment is scheduled for September 15, while refunds and credit of shares to successful applicants are expected on September 16.

Arcil IPO allotment status via MUFG Intime India — Registrar

Step 1. Visit MUFG Intime IPO allotment page at https://in.mpms.mufg.com/Initial_Offer/public-issues.html
Step 2. Select Asset Reconstruction Company (India) Ltd from the company list.
Step 3. Choose the relevant identification option, such as PAN, application number or DP/Client ID.
Step 4. Enter the required details.
Step 5. Submit the form to view the allotment status.

Arcil IPO allotment status via BSE

1. Visit BSE IPO application status page at https://www.bseindia.com/investors/appli_check
2. Select Equity as the issue type.
3. Choose Asset Reconstruction Company (India) Limited from the issue dropdown.
4. Enter your PAN or application number.
5. Complete the captcha and click on Search.
6. The allotment status will appear on the screen.

Arcil IPO allotment status via NSE

Step 1. Visit NSE IPO bid verification page at https://www.nseindia.com/invest/check-trades-bids-verify-ipo-bids
Step 2. Select Equity &amp; SME IPO bid details.
Step 3. Choose ARCIL from the symbol list.
Step 4. Enter your PAN or application number.
Step 5. Submit the details to check the bid and allotment information.

The Rs 732.97-crore IPO consists entirely of an OFS of 5.27 crore equity shares. Since no fresh shares are being issued, the proceeds, after issue-related expenses, will accrue to the selling shareholders rather than Arcil.

The selling shareholders include Avenue India Resurgence, State Bank of India, Lathe Investment and Federal Bank. Avenue India Resurgence and SBI are among the key shareholders participating in the offer.

Before the IPO opened for subscription, Arcil raised Rs 219.89 crore through its anchor book. The company allotted around 1.58 crore shares to 21 institutional investors.

The anchor allocation included global investors such as Goldman Sachs, Ashoka WhiteOak ICAV, Societe Generale, BofA Securities Europe and Integrated Core Strategies. Domestic mutual funds also participated through schemes managed by White Oak Capital, Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC, Bandhan Mutual Fund, Tata Mutual Fund, JM Financial Mutual Fund and Groww Mutual Fund.

Arcil reported revenue of around Rs 753 crore in FY26, up 26.3 percent from Rs 596.4 crore in FY25. Profit increased 14.8 percent to Rs 407.8 crore in FY26 from Rs 355.3 crore a year earlier.

Check IPO News Here

The company has been operating in India's asset reconstruction market since its incorporation in 2003. It acquires stressed financial assets from banks and financial institutions and works on their resolution through mechanisms including restructuring, settlements and enforcement of security interests.

The IPO opened on September 9 and closed on September 11. The basis of allotment is scheduled for September 15, followed by refunds and demat credit on September 16. The shares are expected to make their debut on the BSE and NSE on September 17.

IIFL Capital Services, IDBI Capital Markets &amp; Securities and JM Financial are the book-running lead managers, while MUFG Intime India Private Limited is the registrar to the issue.
